description: PART 2 -- Record-aware MAINFRAME editor SAVE: STOP-AND-REPORT. Investigation of the live CE/SAVE code concludes this CANNOT be delivered by wiring a BackendEnvironment sibling at the existing seam without a FRAMEWORK CHANGE the current CR does not fund. This FEAT records the finding + the exact prerequisites, defers the build, and changes NO .rs behaviour (native/host SAVE stays byte-identical). It then raises a send_message warning so the owner decides: accept the deferral and proceed to FEAT-003, or open a separate owner-confirmed framework-change slice.
steps: Read context.json (stop_and_report field) and plan.md Part 2 FIRST. Re-confirm the five evidence points by reading: crates/ff-vfs/src/backend_environment.rs (save(path,bytes) byte-write contract); crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/environment_registry.rs (closed RegisteredEnv enum + single host_fs backend); crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/commands_environment.rs (dispatch_to_environment matches the closed enum, only HostFsPlaceholder saves); crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/render_body.rs::open_mainframe_dsn + render_body_arms.rs (opens via file.open with NO owning_env -> binds HOSTFS; nav rejects mainframe editing); crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/construct_provider.rs (live provider registry seeded only with host-FS 'local'); docs/specs/command-environments/requirements.md Req 16 Marking (mainframe CE housed in ff-idcams, built later) + Req 17.4 (provider prerequisite).

Write .agents/tasks/rcb8-dataset-rationalisation/part2-mainframe-save-stop.md recording the five evidence points and the concrete prerequisites a future slice needs: (a) owner-confirmed record-aware BackendEnvironment contract (or a record-aware addressing variant carrying DSN + attributes + records, not (path,bytes)); (b) an open named-backend registry + a dispatch_to_environment arm for it; (c) open_mainframe_dsn passing owning_env="MAINFRAME" and binding the tab; (d) the mainframe VFS provider registered live (Req 17.4); (e) the mainframe CE housed in ff-idcams implementing the contract over DatasetAccess. State clearly that making ff-vfs::BackendEnvironment record-aware is a FRAMEWORK CHANGE requiring express owner confirmation.

Make NO .rs behaviour change. Confirm native/host SAVE is untouched by running cargo test -p ff-desktop (the save_active_tab_via_backend tests in tab_manager.rs and host_path_open_is_unchanged_by_the_live_provider_registry in shell/tests_session.rs must stay green).

Set FEAT-002.status to completed with findings summarising the STOP, then call send_message severity 'warning' to the owner: summarise the finding + prerequisites and ask whether to accept the deferral (proceed to FEAT-003) or open a separate framework-change slice. Record anything the convergence/merge steps need in findings.
acceptance_criteria: part2-mainframe-save-stop.md exists and records the five code-grounded evidence points plus the five prerequisites.
No .rs file behaviour changed by this FEAT; native/host SAVE is byte-identical (cargo test -p ff-desktop save/provider tests green).
A send_message warning to the owner states the STOP finding and the explicit decision requested (deferral vs a separate owner-confirmed framework-change slice).
The deferral is recorded so FEAT-003 and the merge step do not treat Part 2 as built.
verification: read_file confirms .agents/tasks/rcb8-dataset-rationalisation/part2-mainframe-save-stop.md exists with the evidence + prerequisites
git status (read-only) shows no .rs behaviour edits attributable to this FEAT
findings: STOP-AND-REPORT (docs-only, NO .rs behaviour change). Re-confirmed the five code-grounded evidence points by reading the live files: (1) ff-vfs/src/backend_environment.rs -- BackendEnvironment::save(&self, path: &Path, bytes: &[u8]) is a byte-write; carries no DSN/RECFM/LRECL/Record boundaries, so routing records through ff_dscatalog::DatasetAccess needs changing (or extending) this load-bearing ff-vfs trait = a FRAMEWORK CHANGE requiring express owner confirmation. (2) ff-desktop/src/shell/environment_registry.rs -- EnvironmentRegistry is a CLOSED enum RegisteredEnv{FfCmdBase,FfEdit,HostFsPlaceholder} + a single host_fs backend; no named-backend map, no MAINFRAME entry. (3) ff-desktop/src/shell/commands_environment.rs -- dispatch_to_environment matches that closed enum; only HostFsPlaceholder saves. (4) ff-desktop/src/shell/render_body.rs::open_mainframe_dsn resolves a DSN to a host PATH string; render_body_arms.rs/render_nav.rs then dispatch file.open with ONLY path (no owning_env) -> tab binds DEFAULT_OWNING_ENVIRONMENT='HOSTFS'; no live path produces a MAINFRAME-owned editable tab. (5) ff-desktop/src/shell/construct_provider.rs::build_live_provider_registry seeds ONLY the host-FS 'local' provider; the mainframe VFS provider is unregistered (command-environments Req 17.2/17.4). Spec Req 16 Marking houses the mainframe CE in ff-idcams and defers it to 'a later phase'; no ff-ce-mainframe crate exists. Finding note written: .agents/tasks/rcb8-dataset-rationalisation/part2-mainframe-save-stop.md (five evidence points + five prerequisites a/b/c/d/e). NO .rs file was changed by this FEAT (git status shows the only Part-2 edit is the new docs note; the ff-idcams working-tree changes belong to Part 1/FEAT-001). Native/host SAVE confirmed byte-identical via `cargo test -p ff-desktop`: the relevant tests PASS -- tab_manager save_clears_modified_flag=ok, save_on_untitled_tab_is_noop=ok, shell::tests_session::host_path_open_is_unchanged_by_the_live_provider_registry=ok, plugin_provider_registers_into_the_live_registry_and_is_resolvable=ok (1000 passed). Two UNRELATED tests failed under the full parallel bin suite -- shell::tests_menu_workspace::theme_follow_os_can_be_set_to_true ('must be readable as true after set') and shell::tests_session::exit_saves_command_history_and_reloads ('on-exit save must write the history file'); both are shared-on-disk config/session file-write isolation flakes under parallel `cargo test`, touch neither save-via-backend nor the mainframe path, and cannot be caused by this FEAT (zero .rs changes). OWNER DECISION (received via parent-session notification): Option 1 -- ACCEPT THE DEFERRAL. Proceed to FEAT-003 (Part 3: delete ff-dataset-catalog + re-express governance). Rationale (owner): the record-aware MAINFRAME SAVE genuinely requires a FRAMEWORK CHANGE (reshaping the load-bearing ff-vfs::BackendEnvironment::save byte contract + opening the closed EnvironmentRegistry enum), which per framework-conformance.md is an owner-confirmed decision NOT part of this CR; spec Req 16 already houses the mainframe CE in ff-idcams and defers it. Req 28 is satisfied by Part 1's repoint; Part 2 is out of RC.B.8's funded scope. Honest-docs recording done per the owner's instruction: (1) TCR docs/quality/TCR.md command-environments Req 16.1 (ff-idcams) kept 🔴 NOT COVERED with a deferral note pointing to part2-mainframe-save-stop.md + 'future owner-gated framework-change slice' -- NO record-aware-SAVE criterion marked PASS; Req 28 rows unchanged (earned by Part 1). (2) idcams-emulator tasks.md -- DEFERRED FOLLOW-UP note under Task 29. (3) project-master tasks.md RC.B.8 row -- Part 1 code-complete / Part 2 deferred (owner-accepted) / Part 3 next sub-notes. (4) docs/status/RESUME-dataset-rationalisation.md -- RC.B.8 status line + OTHER OPEN ITEMS entry logging the deferral and the a-e prerequisites. Part 2 is recorded as DEFERRED so FEAT-003 and the merge step do not treat the record-aware MAINFRAME SAVE as built; Req 28 itself is satisfied by Part 1 (the repoint), the MAINFRAME SAVE being a composing concern, not a 28.x criterion. Prerequisites for a future owner-confirmed framework-change slice are recorded in the note: (a) owner-confirmed record-aware BackendEnvironment contract or record-aware addressing variant carrying DSN+attributes+records; (b) open named-backend registry + dispatch_to_environment arm; (c) open_mainframe_dsn passing owning_env='MAINFRAME' binding the tab; (d) mainframe VFS provider registered live (Req 17.4); (e) mainframe CE housed in ff-idcams implementing the contract over DatasetAccess. Housekeeping: a temporary helper tools/powershell/feat002-isolate.ps1 was left behind (terminal was returning exit -1 and would not register its deletion); it is an ephemeral tools/ script, not a .rs change, and can be removed.
